text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon ran through the Kikuka Sho, 
delivering an earnest performance so 
powerful that it completely overturned the 
spectators' skepticism.

Returning in an unusually high-spirited 
mood, she showed a radiant attitude, 
declaring that this is just the beginning.

Having finished the showdown, she turned 
to her Trainer with a serious expression, 
saying, "There's something I need to talk 
to you about."
